name: Cross Days
source:
Yuuki first met Kotonoha at the school library in the beginning of second semester, but there was no progress with their relationship. They just frequently came to the school library... One day, he sees Roka at the school library and he meets her again through his older sister, Chie, on the same night. Yuuki gradually falls in love with Roka. Roka is also attracted to Yuuki. Their love, however, doesn't go smoothly...

Yuuki hears a rumor that Roka is in love with Makoto. Later he hears that Makoto is close to another girl... Yuuki decides to ask Kotonoha, Makoto's girlfriend, about it to make it clear the fact. From that day, Yuuki's eventful school life starts...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
第二学期伊始，勇气在学校图书馆初次遇见言叶，但两人的关系一直没有进展。他们只是经常在图书馆碰面……某天，勇气在图书馆看见路夏，当晚又通过姐姐知惠与她再次相遇。勇气渐渐喜欢上路夏，路夏也被勇气吸引。然而，两人的恋情并不顺利……

勇气听说路夏喜欢诚。后来，他又听闻诚与另一名女孩关系亲密……为了弄清事实，勇气决定向诚的女友言叶询问此事。从那天起，勇气波澜不断的校园生活拉开了序幕……
